text: OCR processor extracts text and structured content from PDF documents and images
quote: Use the Document AI OCR processor to extract text and structured content from PDF documents and images.

text: Tables can be output as null, markdown, or HTML via a table_format parameter
quote: Table formatting supports null, markdown, and html values through the table_format parameter.

text: Headers and footers can be extracted separately into dedicated response fields
quote: Header and footer extraction uses the extract_header and extract_footer parameters.

text: Block-level extraction returns paragraph bounding boxes, structural labels, and content in reading order
quote: Block extraction uses the include_blocks parameter. When enabled, each page contains a blocks array with paragraph-level bounding boxes, structural block labels, and extracted content in reading order.

text: Confidence scores can be returned at page, block, or word granularity
quote: Confidence scores are available for extracted content at page, block, or word granularity through the confidence_scores_granularity parameter.

text: OCR performs strongly across more than 40 languages
quote: Multilingual OCR performs strongly across more than 40 languages.

text: bbox_annotation feature annotates extracted bounding boxes (e.g. charts/figures) per a user-supplied format
quote: bbox_annotation: gives you the annotation of the bboxes extracted by the OCR model (charts/ figures etc) based on user requirement and provided bbox/image annotation format.

text: document_annotation feature returns a whole-document annotation based on a user-supplied format
quote: document_annotation: returns the annotation of the entire document based on the provided document annotation format.

text: Can extract vendor details and amounts from invoices for accounting automation
quote: Extraction of key information like vendor details and amounts from invoices for automated accounting.

text: Can capture merchant names and transaction amounts from receipts for expense management
quote: Capture of receipt data, including merchant names and transaction amounts, for expense management.

text: Can extract key clauses and terms from contracts for review and management
quote: Extraction of key clauses and terms from contracts for easier review and management

text: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM to enable natural-language interaction with document content
quote: The Document QnA capability combines OCR with large language model capabilities to enable natural language interaction with document content.

text: OCR works on low-quality or handwritten image sources
quote: OCR with image: even from low-quality or handwritten sources.

text: PDFs can be provided via public URL, base64 encoding, or direct file upload
quote: For PDFs, pass a publicly available URL, pass a Base64-encoded PDF, or upload a PDF file.

text: Accepts a broad range of document/image formats (PNG, JPEG, AVIF, PDF, PPTX, DOCX, etc.) through one API
quote: Document formats include: `image_url`: PNG, JPEG/JPG, AVIF, and other image formats. `document_url`: PDF, PPTX, DOCX, and other document formats.
